plain_description.what: Tries to fit the 'widener' (a correction that inflates uncertainty so that separations between models are not over-called) using only the 75 per-cell comparisons among the top (frontier) models. It also checks whether the rule that keeps the frontier 'banded' (left unordered) holds. No judge calls.
plain_description.why: It checks whether the calibration of the separation certificate can be verified in the frontier region, where the judge is weakest.
plain_description.information: A readable calibration status would tell us whether frontier separations can be trusted. Result: done. The criterion fails by simple arithmetic: 75 comparisons are too few to ever reach a readable status, so the status is undetermined. 'Banded by rule' is confirmed on the pooled board (0 of 6 frontier pairs ordered), but on the per-cell edges it is only a manual override. A correction fitted away from the frontier detectably under-covers frontier errors. Older p2dca question family, later ruled 'history, not evidence'.
